evaluation_title: Historical Backtest Report: Crop Planning & Crash Risk Guidance
honest_evaluation_summary: Across 6 historical seasons, the guidance engine correctly identified the severe Kharif 2024 Rayalaseema Tomato crash, alerting farmers to severe price-crash risk (100% crash warning rate). However, in 1 season (Late Kharif 2025 Annamayya Tomato), the model generated a FALSE ALARM: it flagged high crash risk due to heavy initial planting, but unseasonal cyclone storms destroyed crops across Maharashtra, turning what would have been a glut into a price spike. This illustrates the fundamental limit of regional planting models: weather disruptions outside the state cannot be known at planting time.

cases.honest_failure_analysis: FALSE ALARM: Model predicted high crash risk based on regional over-planting, but unseasonal extreme rainfall destroyed competing harvests elsewhere in India, transforming an expected local glut into an unexpected national shortage.
